title: ccusage 설치방법
content:
ccusage reads local usage data from coding agent CLIs and turns it into daily, weekly, monthly, and session reports.
https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage


A desktop viewer for the ccusage CLI. It gives the same rich analytics in a native window – charts, live session monitor, navigation – using the JSON output of the command-line tool.
